summary: Buenaventura filed a routine Form 6-K (foreign issuer current report) furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 earnings release. No transaction, stake, or corporate action is disclosed. Highlights: 3Q26 revenue US$545.3M (+27% YoY), EBITDA from direct operations US$261.2M (vs US$195.3M), net income US$268.4M (vs US$179.0M); 9M26 net income US$825.4M. Cash was US$1,000.6M with negative net debt of US$307.3M. The board approved a dividend of US$0.5508 per share/ADS; a conference call is scheduled for October 30, 2026. This is an ordinary results filing, not a special situation.
